name: vm-provision
description: The inside of an incus guest, converged repeatedly over `incus exec` — packages, files, units — with a digest so a second apply changes nothing
instructions: Host-converging module: reaches the guest through `../incus-core` (and so `../host-exec`), and records what it has already run through `../provision-core`. Import the `vm` instance it provisions so a targeted apply converges them in order; it inherits that vm's `target`, so a remote guest is provisioned the same way a local one is.
